new.brief: Creates a new `GtkBuilderCScope` object to use with future `GtkBuilder` instances.
new.md:
Creates a new `GtkBuilderCScope` object to use with future
`GtkBuilder` instances.

Calling this function is only necessary if you want to add
custom callbacks via [`BuilderCScope.add_callback_symbol()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.BuilderCScope#method:add_callback_symbol).

doc.brief: A `GtkBuilderScope` implementation for the C language.
doc.md:
A `GtkBuilderScope` implementation for the C language.

`GtkBuilderCScope` instances use symbols explicitly added to `builder`
with prior calls to [`BuilderCScope.add_callback_symbol()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.BuilderCScope#method:add_callback_symbol).
If developers want to do that, they are encouraged to create their
own scopes for that purpose.

In the case that symbols are not explicitly added; GTK will uses
`GModule`’s introspective features (by opening the module `NULL`) to
look at the application’s symbol table. From here it tries to match
the signal function names given in the interface description with
symbols in the application.

Note that unless [`BuilderCScope.add_callback_symbol()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.BuilderCScope#method:add_callback_symbol) is
called for all signal callbacks which are referenced by the loaded XML,
this functionality will require that `GModule` be supported on the platform.

add_callback_symbol.brief: Adds the `callback_symbol` to the scope of `builder` under the given `callback_name`.
add_callback_symbol.md:
Adds the `callback_symbol` to the scope of `builder` under the
given `callback_name`.

Using this function overrides the behavior of
[`Builder.create_closure()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder#method:create_closure) for any callback symbols that
are added. Using this method allows for better encapsulation as it
does not require that callback symbols be declared in the global
namespace.

add_callback_symbols.brief: A convenience function to add many callbacks.
add_callback_symbols.md:
A convenience function to add many callbacks.

This is equivalent to calling [`BuilderCScope.add_callback_symbol()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.BuilderCScope#method:add_callback_symbol)
for each symbol.

lookup_callback_symbol.brief: Fetches a symbol previously added with gtk_builder_cscope_add_callback_symbol().
lookup_callback_symbol.md:
Fetches a symbol previously added with
gtk_builder_cscope_add_callback_symbol().
